blocks.text: Worldwide, lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death. Approximately 85 %–90% of lung cancer cases are caused by smoking. There are two main types of lung cancer: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC). These two types have different prognosis and management approach.

With advanced radiotherapy machines and treatment techniques, RT may be given for neo–adjuvant or adjuvant to surgery. Palliative Radiotherapy is frequently used in metastatic disease to bone, spinal cord compression, brain, liver, and in case of superior vena cava obstruction (SVCO), atelectasis, obstructive pneumonitis, and fungating masses. A dose of 30GY/10 Fractions/2weeks gives good symptom relief.

blocks.text: SCLC is characterized by early development of widespread metastases. It is highly sensitive to initial chemotherapy and radiotherapy; however, most patients eventually die of recurrent disease.
